Where Are The Posts?

Andy CASA, UCL East

For the next 10 days i am on Jury Service, which is making it kind of tricky to post on the blog.

However as laptops are allowed in the waiting area between sitting on cases a few longer and more detailed posts will be possible over the next week or so.

We hope to post our thoughts on future technologies, technologies to watch over the next 6 months and people who have set up companies based on the information posted on digital urban.

Hopefully more posts will be possible, for now we note that the images have disappeared from our Google PhotoOverlay Creator Tutorial and Software Download so we are off to fix it.....
